title: VMware vCenter Server (vSphere Automation API) connector configuration

endpoint_port.description: 443 is vCenter's confirmed default HTTPS management port for the vSphere Automation API.

credential_reference_id.description: References a username:password pair, not a pre-built Authorization header -- vCenter's real Automation API is session-based (POST /api/session, HTTP Basic auth). See source-provenance.json.
